name: American Airlines Group Inc.
reason: Commodity airline with fuel- and cycle-driven earnings: EPS fell from $9.12 (2015) to $0.36 (2025, 0.04x 10y max), 10y avg ROIC -0.1% and net debt/EBITDA 7.65x - fails balance-sheet and predictability tests.

name: Acadian Asset Management Inc.
reason: Quant asset manager whose fees track markets and performance flows; revenue CAGR -1.5% over 10y with EPS growth driven by buybacks (2.0x FCF) - capital-markets dependent and not special.

name: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc.
reason: Optical transceiver maker with losses in 7 straight years (2019-25), 10y avg ROIC -11.5%, negative FCF yield and 13.8%/yr share dilution; earnings hinge on a few hyperscaler customers and product cycles.

name: AbbVie, Inc.
reason: Strong immunology franchise (Skyrizi/Rinvoq) but EPS is still 0.73x its 2022 peak after the Humira cliff, the adjusted-vs-GAAP gap averages 232%, and IRA price negotiation plus the next patent cliffs make 10-year earnings hard to forecast.

name: Abbott Laboratories
reason: Diversified, conservatively financed (0.46x net debt/EBITDA) healthcare leader with 9.1% 10y EPS CAGR, CGM (Libre) and structural-heart secular drivers and consensus 10-11% EPS growth; EPS 0.96x a COVID-testing-inflated peak is not a cyclical top, though NEC infant-formula litigation needs checking.

name: ACADIA Pharmaceuticals Inc.
reason: Single-product CNS biotech (Nuplazid, plus Daybue) only profitable since 2024 with EBIT margin 9.8% at its high; patent exposure and pipeline binaries, and the 7.2% FCF yield rests on consensus not a recurring record.

name: Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc.
reason: Behavioral hospital operator with EPS down 39% in 2025 to 0.58x 10y max, margin at 9th percentile, net debt/EBITDA 4.37x, LTM FCF yield -16% (the 6.6% is a consensus forecast) and active government investigations/litigation over billing and patient care.

name: ACI Worldwide Incorporated
reason: Mature payments-software vendor with 5.3% revenue CAGR, 10y avg ROIC 5.5% and EBIT margin at a 91st-percentile 19.3%; sticky bank installs but no widening moat or secular edge over modern real-time payment platforms - ordinary.

name: Agree Realty Corporation
reason: High-quality net-lease REIT but FFO/share grew only 6.1%/yr over 10y while shares compounded 19.9%/yr - growth is externally funded by equity and debt (net debt/EBITDA 5.7x), and consensus FFO growth is 0-7%.

name: Autodesk, Inc.
reason: Entrenched design-software standard (AutoCAD/Revit) in AEC and manufacturing with subscription model, 28.6% 10y EPS CAGR, net cash-neutral balance sheet and consensus 12-14% EPS growth; margin at 10y high reflects the subscription transition, though AI disruption of design workflows and SBC (89.6% adj vs GAAP gap) need checking.

name: Addus HomeCare Corporation
reason: Steady 18.7% 10y EPS CAGR but revenue is mostly Medicaid-funded personal care, so state reimbursement and federal Medicaid cuts are a credible 5-year threat, and growth was acquisition-driven (acquisitions 1.78x FCF, shares +5.1%/yr).

name: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc.
reason: Power-conversion supplier to semiconductor equipment and data centres; EPS has swung between $2.44 and $6.49 with semi-capex cycles, EBIT margin fell from 29.9% to 11.5%, and the current surge (consensus +76%) depends on AI capex.

name: Aflac Incorporated
reason: Supplemental insurer earning mainly in a shrinking Japan market (revenue CAGR -1.9% over 10y); EPS growth of 9.3% came from buybacks and yen/rate effects with EPS at its 10y high and consensus only -6% to +9% - disciplined but not special.

name: Affirm Holdings, Inc.
reason: BNPL consumer lender only profitable since FY2025; earnings depend on credit losses, funding spreads and capital-markets access (ntm P/E 32x, net debt/EBITDA 3.4x) - an interest-rate/credit-cycle business that cannot be forecast with confidence.

name: AGNT, Inc.
reason: Agent-based residential brokerage (formerly eXp) with near-zero EBIT margin (-0.4%), negative EPS in 2025 and earnings tied to housing transaction volumes; the 18.5% FCF yield is pass-through agent equity compensation, not owner earnings.

name: Argan, Inc.
reason: Debt-free power-plant EPC contractor at peak economics (EPS $9.74 = 1.0x 10y max, margin 82nd percentile after a loss in 2019) with lumpy fixed-price projects; FCF (8.2% yield) is inflated by customer advance billings rather than recurring cash.

name: AdaptHealth Corp.
reason: Roll-up home-medical-equipment supplier (acquisitions 3.0x FCF) with Medicare competitive-bidding reimbursement risk, EPS 0.37x its 2021 peak, negative NTM consensus EPS and net debt/EBITDA 2.8x.

name: AAR CORP.
reason: Aviation aftermarket distributor/MRO whose recent growth came from acquisitions (4.66x 10y FCF) with weak FCF conversion (0.35), 10y avg ROIC 4.9% and EBIT margin at a 91st-percentile 8.5% in a hot aerospace cycle.

name: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.
reason: Excellent insurance broker culture and 15.2% 10y EPS CAGR, but growth leans heavily on acquisitions (1.95x FCF, shares +4.1%/yr, net debt/EBITDA 3.3x after AssuredPartners) and on a firm P&C pricing cycle now softening.

name: Antero Midstream Corp.
reason: Gathering and water system dedicated to a single customer (Antero Resources) in Appalachian gas, so volumes depend on one producer's drilling plans and gas prices; net debt/EBITDA 3.2x with margin at 89th percentile.
